traitdesc-smith: Can craft and use repair kits to repair armor, a more efficient torch holder, the necessary parts for a rucksack and blacksmith gloves.
traitdesc-backpacker: Countless journeys have taught you how to reinforce and expand your backpacks, turning simple packs into sturdier and more spacious gear. As well as this highly customizable rucksack.
traitdesc-prospector: Exclusive craftables copper pan, mining lantern and the resonant anchor.
